newsitem.title: USA: Homestake files shelf for up to 20 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Homestake files shelf for up to 20 mln shrs.

text.p: Homestake Mining Co said Monday it had filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the potential sale of up to 20 million shares of common stock.
The company said proceeds would go toward general corporate purposes, including possible acquisitions that it said could add to its gold reserves and future gold production.

Homestake Mining has gold mining operations in the United States, Canada and Australia. It also has active gold exploration programs in Venezuela, French Guiana, Chile, Brazil and elsewhere in Latin America and development and/or evaluation projects in Chile, Russia and Bulgaria.
